title.zh: 中国
title.en: China

title.zh: 中国三季度GDP同比增长4.5%，好于预期
title.en: China's Q3 GDP grows 4.5%, beating forecasts

summary.zh: 国家统计局10月19日公布，中国三季度GDP同比增长4.5%，高于市场预期的4.4%，也快于二季度的4.3%；前三季度增长4.6%。9月工业增加值增长5.5%，社会消费品零售总额增长1.1%，但前九个月固定资产投资下降7.2%，房地产开发投资降幅更大，内需依然偏弱。
summary.en: China's economy grew 4.5% year on year in the third quarter, the National Bureau of Statistics said on Oct. 19, beating the 4.4% forecast and up from 4.3% in the second quarter. Growth for January to September was 4.6%. Industrial output rose 5.5% in September and retail sales 1.1%, but fixed-asset investment fell 7.2% in the first nine months, with property investment falling even faster.

title.zh: 香港再有74幢大厦电梯缺防火门框，总数增至152幢
title.en: Hong Kong: 74 more buildings have lifts missing safety parts, total now 152

summary.zh: 机电工程署周日表示，泰昌电梯（Taizoom）维修的电梯中，又有74幢大厦缺少防火门框，累计达152幢，另有约180幢尚待检查。警方已拘捕该公司一名董事及两名注册电梯工程师，涉嫌就完工证明作出欺诈；所有注册电梯承办商被要求检视过去十年的同类工程。
summary.en: Hong Kong's Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said on Sunday that lifts in 74 more Taizoom-serviced buildings lack fire-resistant door frames, bringing the total to 152, with about 180 still to be inspected. Police have arrested a Taizoom director and two registered lift engineers on suspicion of deception over safety certificates. All registered lift contractors have been told to review similar work from the past decade.

title.zh: 普京提议与特朗普、习近平举行三方峰会谈乌克兰
title.en: Putin proposes summit with Trump and Xi on Ukraine

summary.zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，普京在10月9日与特朗普通话时提出三方峰会，讨论结束乌克兰战争，泽连斯基不在受邀之列。克里姆林宫确认双方有接触，但称会面本身及议程尚不明确；美方官员说特朗普尚未同意，但可能持开放态度。有消息称莫斯科希望在11月18至19日深圳APEC峰会期间举行。
summary.en: The Wall Street Journal reports that Vladimir Putin raised a three-way summit with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping during an Oct. 9 phone call, aimed at a Ukraine deal without Zelensky at the table. The Kremlin says there is no clear understanding yet about the meeting or its agenda, and a senior U.S. official says Trump has not agreed but may be open. Moscow reportedly suggested the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen on Nov. 18 to 19.

title.zh: 大多伦多地区
title.en: Greater Toronto Area

title.zh: 北约克水管爆裂，Sheppard东路部分封闭
title.en: Water main break closes part of Sheppard Avenue East in North York

summary.zh: 周日清晨，多伦多北约克Sheppard Avenue East与Leslie Street交汇处附近发生水管爆裂，Leslie街至Ambrose路一段封闭，附近用户受到影响。市政府表示修复可能需要24小时甚至更久，何时重开尚不确定；居民可致电311报告。
summary.en: A water main burst early Sunday along Sheppard Avenue East near Leslie Street in North York, closing Sheppard from Leslie west to Ambrose Road and affecting nearby customers. The city says repairs can take 24 hours or longer, and it is not yet clear when the road will reopen. Residents can report breaks by calling 311.

title.zh: Royal LePage：大多伦多地区三季度房价同比跌3.7%
title.en: Royal LePage: GTA home prices down 3.7% year over year in Q3

summary.zh: Royal LePage第三季度调查显示，大多伦多地区房屋综合均价为1,073,100加元，同比下降3.7%；多伦多市为1,071,500加元，同比微降0.5%。该机构预计第四季度大多地区房价将同比再降约2%。
summary.en: Royal LePage's third-quarter survey puts the GTA aggregate home price at $1,073,100, down 3.7% from a year earlier. In the City of Toronto the price was $1,071,500, down 0.5%. The company expects GTA prices to fall about 2% year over year in the fourth quarter.

title.zh: 多伦多滨水马拉松：肯尼亚选手朗加特卫冕，杰鲁托夺冠
title.en: Toronto Waterfront Marathon: Langat repeats, Jeruto wins women's race

summary.zh: 周日的多伦多滨水马拉松上，肯尼亚的伦纳德·朗加特以2小时06分51秒卫冕男子冠军；莉亚·杰鲁托在最后10公里发力，以2小时21分19秒首次在马拉松赛中夺冠。加拿大选手戴维斯以2:08:48获加拿大男子冠军，皮多雷斯基以2:26:08第二次夺得加拿大女子冠军。
summary.en: At Sunday's Toronto Waterfront Marathon, Kenya's Leonard Langat defended his men's title in 2:06:51, while Leah Jeruto surged in the final 10 kilometres to win her first career marathon in 2:21:19. Andrew Davies took the Canadian men's title in 2:08:48, and Dayna Pidhoresky won her second Canadian women's title in 2:26:08.

title.zh: 安省市政选举10月26日投票，多地提前投票已开始
title.en: Ontario municipal election set for Oct. 26 as advance voting runs across the GTA

summary.zh: 安大略省市政选举将于10月26日举行，多伦多周边多个城市的提前投票已经开始。布兰普顿市长帕特里克·布朗正在竞选连任。
summary.en: Ontario's municipal elections are on Oct. 26, and advance voting is already under way in several GTA cities. Brampton Mayor Patrick Brown is seeking re-election.

title.zh: 全国
title.en: National

title.zh: 阿尔伯塔温赖特军事基地大火致4名军人死亡
title.en: Fire at CFB Wainwright in Alberta kills four service members

summary.zh: 周六，阿尔伯塔省温赖特加拿大军事基地一处户外训练场地发生迅速蔓延的火灾，造成4名军人死亡、39人受伤，其中至少19人情况危急。遇难者来自埃德蒙顿的公主团第3营。国防部称起火原因仍在调查，没有迹象显示与恐怖活动有关；总理卡尼说全国都在哀悼。
summary.en: A fast-moving fire during an outdoor training exercise at CFB Wainwright in Alberta on Saturday killed four service members and injured 39, at least 19 of them critically. The dead served with the 3rd Battalion, Princess Patricia's Canadian Light Infantry, based in Edmonton. The cause is under investigation and defence officials say there is no indication of terrorism; Prime Minister Mark Carney said the nation is mourning.

title.zh: 阿尔伯塔周一就去留举行公投，卡尼与史密斯分歧明显
title.en: Alberta votes Monday on staying in Canada; Carney and Smith split on other questions

summary.zh: 阿尔伯塔省10月19日举行含10道题的公投，核心问题是选择留在加拿大，还是启动第二次具约束力的分离公投程序。卡尼与省长史密斯都表示在该题投“留在加拿大”，但对政府提出的其余九道有关移民和宪法的问题，卡尼呼吁投反对票，史密斯则支持。
summary.en: Albertans vote on Oct. 19 on a 10-question ballot. The key question asks whether to remain in Canada or begin a process toward a second, binding referendum on separation. Carney and Premier Danielle Smith both back staying in Canada, but they split on the other nine questions on immigration and constitutional changes: Carney urged a no, while Smith supports a yes.

title.zh: 国际
title.en: World

title.zh: 欧洲多国爆发生活成本抗议，法国约55万人上街
title.en: Cost-of-living protests spread across Europe; about 550,000 march in France

summary.zh: 据法国内政部统计，周六全国约有55万人参加抗议，诉求涉及燃油和生活成本、教育与公共服务。意大利米兰等北部城市出现冲突，葡萄牙里斯本等地数万人就住房问题游行，布鲁塞尔警方也动用了催泪瓦斯。有报道称法国官员正研究宵禁措施，具体伤亡数字仍在核实。
summary.en: France's interior ministry put turnout at about 550,000 nationwide on Saturday, as demonstrators protested fuel prices, the cost of living, education and public services. Unrest hit Italian cities including Milan, tens of thousands marched over housing in Portugal, and Brussels police used tear gas. French officials are reportedly exploring curfews; casualty figures are still preliminary.

title.zh: 体育
title.en: Sports

title.zh: 阿森纳客场1-0击败诺丁汉森林，马杜埃凯80分钟制胜
title.en: Arsenal edge Nottingham Forest 1-0 on Madueke's 80th-minute goal

summary.zh: 英超周日，替补登场的马杜埃凯在第80分钟破门，阿森纳客场1比0战胜诺丁汉森林。
summary.en: In Sunday's Premier League action, substitute Noni Madueke scored in the 80th minute as Arsenal beat Nottingham Forest 1-0 away from home.

title.zh: 曼联客场1-1战平利兹联
title.en: Leeds United and Manchester United draw 1-1

summary.zh: 姆伯莫先为曼联破门，利兹联的卡尔弗特-勒温在下半场扳平，双方1比1收场。
summary.en: Bryan Mbeumo opened the scoring for Manchester United, and Dominic Calvert-Lewin equalised for Leeds in the second half to make it 1-1.

title.zh: 皇马4-1大胜塞维利亚，姆巴佩梅开二度
title.en: Real Madrid beat Sevilla 4-1 as Mbappé scores twice

summary.zh: 西甲周日，姆巴佩梅开二度，居勒尔和迪奥芒德各入一球，皇马在伯纳乌4比1击败塞维利亚，下周将迎战巴萨的国家德比。
summary.en: Kylian Mbappé scored twice, with Arda Güler and Yan Diomande also scoring, as Real Madrid beat Sevilla 4-1 at the Bernabéu on Sunday. Sevilla's goal came from Manu Bueno. Madrid now turn to next week's El Clásico.

title.zh: 上海大师赛：达维多维奇·福基纳三盘逆转夺首个大师赛冠军
title.en: Davidovich Fokina fights back to win Shanghai Masters title

summary.zh: 决赛中，西班牙人达维多维奇·福基纳以1-6、7-6(5)、6-4逆转同胞约达尔，生涯首夺ATP大师赛1000冠军。
summary.en: Alejandro Davidovich Fokina came from a set down to beat fellow Spaniard Rafael Jodar 1-6, 7-6(5), 6-4 in the Shanghai final, winning his first ATP Masters 1000 title.

title.zh: 武汉网球公开赛：赫瓦利诺夫斯卡逆转夺生涯首个WTA冠军
title.en: Chwalińska wins first WTA title at Wuhan Open

summary.zh: 波兰选手马娅·赫瓦利诺夫斯卡在决赛中以2-6、6-4、6-2逆转卡塔尔，赢得职业生涯首个WTA巡回赛单打冠军。
summary.en: Poland's Maja Chwalińska rallied to beat Sonay Kartal 2-6, 6-4, 6-2 in the Wuhan Open final for her first career WTA singles title.

title.zh: MLB美联冠军赛：光芒3-1骑士，总比分3-2领先
title.en: ALCS Game 5: Rays beat Guardians 3-1 to lead series 3-2

summary.zh: 光芒队先发拉斯穆森投7局仅失1分，球队3比1战胜克利夫兰守护者，在美联冠军赛中3比2领先，距离世界大赛只差一场胜利。第6场周一在坦帕举行。
summary.en: Drew Rasmussen allowed one run over seven innings as Tampa Bay beat Cleveland 3-1 in Game 5 of the ALCS. The Rays lead the series 3-2 and are one win from the World Series. Game 6 is Monday at Tropicana Field.

title.zh: 枫叶主场1-4不敌岛人，三连败
title.en: Maple Leafs lose 4-1 to Islanders for third straight defeat

summary.zh: 周六晚，纽约岛人在多伦多以4比1击败枫叶，霍瓦特攻入制胜球，霍尔姆斯特罗姆梅开二度，索罗金扑出29球中的28个。枫叶战绩为3-4-2，已连续三场失利。
summary.en: The New York Islanders beat the Maple Leafs 4-1 at Scotiabank Arena on Saturday. Bo Horvat scored the winner, Simon Holmstrom added two goals, and Ilya Sorokin stopped 28 of 29 shots. Toronto, now 3-4-2, has lost three straight.

title.zh: 《街头霸王》首映登顶全球票房，但低于预期
title.en: 'Street Fighter' tops the box office, but short of hopes

summary.zh: 派拉蒙的《街头霸王》全球首映周末收入5,110万美元，其中北美约3,100万美元，位居榜首，但低于外界期待的7,000万美元左右。影片观众评分较高，评论界反应一般。
summary.en: Paramount's Street Fighter opened at No. 1 with $51.1 million worldwide, about $31 million of it in North America, but short of the roughly $70 million some had hoped for. Audiences have been warmer than critics.

title.zh: 奈飞内容主管换人：彼得·赖斯接替巴贾里亚
title.en: Netflix names Peter Rice chief content officer, replacing Bela Bajaria

summary.zh: 据《综艺》报道，奈飞内容总负责人贝拉·巴贾里亚在任十年后离任，由前迪士尼、福克斯高管彼得·赖斯接任，10月26日上任。此事发生在奈飞裁员约6%之际。
summary.en: Variety reports that Bela Bajaria is leaving Netflix after 10 years as chief content officer and will be replaced by former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice, who starts Oct. 26. The change comes as Netflix cuts about 6% of its workforce.

title.zh: 八卦
title.en: Gossip

title.zh: 詹妮弗·洛佩兹与布雷特·戈德斯坦同车现身派对，再引恋情传闻
title.en: Jennifer Lopez and Brett Goldstein spark fresh dating rumours after LA party

summary.zh: 两人周五出席洛杉矶一场派对，据报道分别入场但同车离开，再度引发传闻。此前他们在联合受访时明确表示“没有在约会”，目前双方代表未回应置评请求，传闻来自匿名消息人士和现场目击，尚未证实。
summary.en: The two attended an LA party on Friday and were reportedly seen arriving and leaving in the same car, though they entered separately. In an earlier joint interview they said they are 'not dating', and representatives have not responded to requests for comment. The claims rest on anonymous sources and sightings and are unconfirmed.
